reason: A cross-agent session search plugin that performs literal searches across current local conversation artifacts and reads matching session message windows without creating an index or modifying source files.

summaries.zh: 跨智能体搜索插件，可在本地 dsh、Codex、Claude Code、pi 和 OpenCode 会话记录中搜索文本并读取匹配的消息窗口。
summaries.en: A cross-agent session search plugin for searching local dsh, Codex, Claude Code, pi, and OpenCode conversation artifacts and reading matching message windows.

capabilities: Searches local session artifacts from dsh, Codex, Claude Code, pi, and OpenCode
Reads session metadata and message windows
Parses JSONL, compressed session logs, and an OpenCode SQLite database in read-only mode
